children: In accordance with PRM 1.6.4R, the Company announces that 105,218 ordinary shares of 2 pence each have been issued and admitted to trading as set out in the table below.
Details of the transferable securities admitted to trading
Name, type and ISIN of the securities
Number of further securities admitted to trading covered by this notification
Total number of securities admitted to trading following further issuance
Fully fungible with existing ordinary shares
Date of issuance and admission to trading
Issued on various dates between 30 June 2026 and 26 August 2026.
All issued shares covered by this notification were admitted to trading under an existing block admissions for the Company's SAYE Scheme.

Porvair is a group of specialist filtration, laboratory and environmental technology companies. Our businesses design and manufacture bespoke consumable filtration products that are used in a range of niche markets. It operates in three divisions: Aerospace & Industrial; Laboratory; and Metal Melt Quality.
